grid_config.scope: One unchanged E2 +50 km configuration at 0.25 degree longitude tolerance. All 648 grid targets are planned and executed; no targeting corrections or empirical margins. This is independent of the unavailable 360x180 per-target archive.

scenario.scope: First worked-example diagnostic, not a multi-case or high-fidelity validation. The four fixed-magnitude Hohmann impulses are applied in the instantaneous RTN transverse direction; no trajectory is reset or corrected to hit the target. Surface coordinates use the radial WGS84 subpoint convention declared by the planner.

initialization.note: Numerical averaging convention; not an exact theory-specific mean conversion.

acceptance.matched: Nearest crossing of the nominal branch within +/- half a nominal regional nodal period; original longitude band and time >= regional insertion.
acceptance.geographic_only: Original longitude band at the matched event, independent of whether insertion is complete.
acceptance.extended_window: First acceptable crossing of either branch after insertion through 1.15 nominal repeat intervals; later success does not validate the nominal response.
acceptance.model_error: Wrapped propagated minus nominal longitude at corresponding latitude crossings; distinct from longitude offset from the target.
acceptance.weights: Primary fractions count coordinates equally. Separate spherical cell weights are clipped at +/-49 degrees; neither is a demand distribution.

limitations: One orbit configuration, longitude tolerance and request state; a deterministic coarse grid, not a random sample or a completed 360x180 validation.
Central gravity plus J2 only; fixed ideal Hohmann impulses, without targeting corrections or margins.
The one-orbit numerical mean convention is not an exact theory-specific mean-to-osculating transformation.
Radial WGS84 surface subpoints and common continuous GMST with UT1 approximated by UTC.
Convergence demonstrates numerical stability within this model, not operational truth.
